title: festuca rubra f. dasyphylla
intro: Festuca rubra f. dasyphylla, commonly known as Red Fescue or Sheep's Fescue, is a perennial grass species belonging to the Poaceae family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Festuca rubra f. dasyphylla are primarily attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. However, the specific bioactive constituents responsible for the plant's therapeutic effects are not well-documented, and further research is needed to fully understand its properties and applications.
